profile.headline: Lead Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary: Result-driven Software Engineer with years of experience in full-stack development and operational excellence of backend services at scale. Experienced across the entire SDLC, from requirement gathering and design brainstorming with stakeholders, through code and infrastructure development and rigorous testing, to post-launch support and incident resolution. Proficient in Agile methodology for efficient project delivery and adapting to constant product evolution.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Technology Leadership · IT Leadership · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Microservices · Architectural Design · Figma

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Served as Senior Software Engineer for Ultra Mobile, which was acquired by T-Mobile

positions.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
positions.description:
Among first developer on a brand e-commerce new project. Developed full stack application on Next JS and Node microservices to handle both e-commerce and account management. Work on workflow for purchasing products through microservice architecture.

Technologies: 
- Languages: Typescript | HTML | SCSS | SQL
- Framework: Next JS | Node JS | GraphQL | Redux | Cypress | TailwindCSS
- Cloud: AWS 
- Tool: Git | Vercel | Docker | Bash | Elastic Search

positions.title: Computer analyst II (Full Stack Developer)
positions.description:
Develop web application to automate and track workflow of manufacturing processes. The workflow allows collaboration between teams and improved efficiency and output of products. 

Also involved with expanding capability of in-house applications to develop specialized materials by writing adapters and image recognition plug ins.

Technologies:
- Language: Python | Javascript | SQL | HTML | CSS
- Framework: Flask | JQuery | Bootstrap | PostgresQL
- Tool: Git | Docker | Bash

projects.title: BUGHOUND
projects.description:
• Built backend service in Django and frontend with Bootstrap.

• Users can use web browser to report bugs on multiple products.

• Store reports in relational tables.

• Export reports in XML, CSV, HTML formats.

projects.title: PATTERN RECOGNITION
projects.description:
• Preprocess data and perform feature extractions.

• Analyze data with algorithms: K-nearest neighbors, Hidden Markov, Bayesian, Random Forest, Neural Network.

• Write algorithm from scratch and compare and contrast with built-in Scikit-Learn models.

• KNN: https://github.com/liam-nguyen/KNN

• HMM: https://github.com/liam-nguyen/Hidden-Markov-Model

• Random Forest: https://github.com/liam-nguyen/Random-Forest
